news.headline: IES Holdings Reports Fiscal 2026 Third Quarter Results
news.summary: Q3 revenue rose 40% to $1.24B with operating income of $178.5M, and the company announced a two-for-one stock split.

catalysts.label: Fiscal Q4 2026 results
catalysts.detail: Date unconfirmed: one source says Nov 20, another Dec 9; consensus about $2.81 EPS on ~$1.15B revenue.

pulse: IES is growing quickly, with Q3 revenue up 40% and a stock split announced. The fiscal Q4 report is due in late November or early December. No newer company-specific news was found in the last 45 days.
